versions.changelog:
Version 1.2.0

- Added 452 example files covering various sample scenarios (API configs, database setups, UI assets, etc.) to the repository.
- Removed skill-card.md from the project.
- Expanded documentation and examples to illustrate BIOS and class-hour sample services, including configuration, API, and UI files.
- No core logic changes reported—this release focuses on providing comprehensive examples and resources for developers.

mesh-app-factory 1.0.0

- Initial release of the "至简网格"端&云应用开发工厂 skill.
- Provides documentation on terminology, versioning, and principles of the platform.
- Offers in-depth guide for developing server-side services, including project structure and JSON-based service/database/interface definitions.
- Details simplified configuration and deployment processes for both server and client sides.
- Emphasizes small footprint, simple operations, and integrated security and reliability features.
- Source code and further documentation available at https://gitee.com/zhijian_net/MeshServer.
